description: This file defines a helper class for logging in an Android project, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for custom log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods to log messages at various levels and manage a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log data to the current LogNode, if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority, indicating a critical failure.
